meta.title: 도성 한 바퀴
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (도성 한 바퀴, a walking tour round the Seoul city wall (fictional tour)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 도성 한 바퀴, a walking tour round the Seoul city wall (fictional tour)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Ink on rice paper and nothing else: paper #F1EADC with fibres and a darker edge, ink #16130F in many dilutions (the far ranges at a fifth of full strength, the near ridge at three quarters, strokes near full), one seal red #B8322A; a grey-blue night wash with a warm lantern glow for the night walk.
rationale.type: Nanum Brush Script for the brushed lines, revealed left to right as if written; Song Myung for small labels and gate names; the seal carved in Song Myung.
rationale.motion: A hand scroll: the landscape slides sideways with each range at its own depth; washes bleed in (blur shrinking as they darken), strokes paint themselves with a pressure profile and dry-brush streaks, mist drifts, the seal lands with a press.
rationale.sound: Ambient at 96 BPM in D, snapped to a pentatonic scale (평조, 0 2 4 7 9), koto-like plucks over a pad with light drums; organic SFX: a soft thud for the seal, air for the scroll.
rationale.visuals: All code: ridges from summed sines filled as washes under blur, a wall stroke that follows a ridge with parapet ticks, pines, gate pavilions with upturned eaves, mist, a moon, tiny walkers, a red seal with irregular edges.
